items.applicability: 24小时和7天两级安全放行；只准入已定位Amendment 5.0页面。
items.source_text: Subjects will be enrolled at staggered intervals to facilitate adequate safety evaluation before dosing of subsequent subjects. At 24-hour and 7-day intervals, all available safety data, including dose-limiting toxicities, adverse events, treatment-emergent adverse events, serious adverse events, and pharmacodynamic data including IgG levels, will be reviewed. The first 2 subjects in each cohort will be dosed at least 24 hours apart. A dose escalation committee review of the 24-hour safety data for the first subject in Cohort 1 will be performed before dosing the second subject. The 7-day safety data for the first 2 subjects in Cohort 1 will be reviewed by the dose escalation committee prior to dosing the remaining subjects in the cohort.
items.translated_text: 受试者将以交错间隔入组，以便在后续受试者给药前进行充分的安全性评估。每隔24小时和7天，审查所有可获得的安全性数据，包括剂量限制性毒性、不良事件、治疗期间出现的不良事件、严重不良事件以及包括IgG水平的药效学数据。每个队列的前2名受试者给药间隔至少24小时。在队列1第2名受试者给药前，剂量递增委员会将对第1名受试者的24小时安全性数据进行审查。在队列1其余受试者给药前，剂量递增委员会将对前2名受试者的7天安全性数据进行审查。

items.applicability: 健康受试者SAD与患者MAD的安全性、PK和PD证据衔接；产品事实不得迁移。
items.source_text: Dose escalation for all cohorts will be based upon unanimous decision of the DLRM members. The dosing decisions will be based on the review of safety data during the DLRM. Within each cohort, the safety data will be assessed after all 8 subjects have been enrolled and at least 6 subjects have completed the day 29 visit, which corresponds to receipt of the third dose of investigational product. In addition to the review of safety data, emerging PK and PD data will also be reviewed in a blinded fashion at the DLRM as these data become available. Emerging safety, PK, and PD data from equivalent dose level cohorts of the AMG 570 single ascending dose study in healthy volunteers will also be reviewed prior to dose escalation in the multiple ascending dose study.
items.translated_text: 所有队列的剂量递增将基于DLRM成员的一致决定。给药决策将基于DLRM期间的安全性数据审核。在每个队列中，将在所有8例受试者均完成入组且至少6例受试者完成第29天访视（相当于第3次给予试验用药品）后对安全性数据进行评估。除安全性数据审核外，DLRM还将在新出现的PK和PD数据可用时以盲态对其进行审核。在多次给药剂量递增研究中进行剂量递增前，还将审核来自健康志愿者中AMG 570单次给药剂量递增研究的相同剂量水平队列的新出现的安全性、PK和PD数据。

items.applicability: DLRM分批审查和停止规则；仅Protocol文本可用，SAP扫描文本不准入。

The exception is for cohorts 2 and 3 where an initial DLRM will convene after the first 16 enrolled subjects (8 in each cohort) complete the week 4 visit and a second DLRM will convene after the remaining 16 enrolled subjects (8 in each cohort) complete the week 4 visit. The following dose cohort stopping rules will be used in the phase 1b part of the study. Dosing will be stopped or modified as shown in Table 7-1.
items.translated_text: 当一个队列中的所有可评价受试者均已完成第4周访视后，将召开DLRM以审查数据并做出剂量递增/递减决策。队列2和队列3例外，前16名入组受试者（每个队列8名）完成第4周访视后将召开首次DLRM，剩余16名入组受试者（每个队列8名）完成第4周访视后将召开第二次DLRM。以下剂量队列停止规则将用于本研究的1b期部分。给药将按表7-1所示停止或调整。

items.applicability: Topical patient study with sentinel release after Day 19 medical-monitor review.
items.source_text:
The study is proposed as a randomized, double-blinded, vehicle and active
comparator-controlled, multiple dose study in subjects with psoriasis. Subjects will receive
topical doses (2.3%, 0.8% and 0.23%) of PF-06763809, PF-06763809 vehicle, and two active
comparators in this study. In order to mitigate any unanticipated safety risks, sentinel dosing
approach will be employed for this study. Two sentinel subjects will be dosed first for
18 days with all six treatments. The sponsor medical monitor will communicate with the
investigator as soon as sentinel subjects complete Day 19, in order to determine whether it is
safe to proceed with dosing of remaining subjects.
items.translated_text: 本研究计划在银屑病受试者中开展一项随机、双盲、赋形剂和阳性对照药对照的多次给药研究。受试者将接受局部剂量（2.3%、0.8%和0.23%）的PF-06763809、PF-06763809赋形剂和两种阳性对照药。为减轻任何未预料到的安全性风险，本研究将采用哨兵给药方法。两名哨兵受试者将首先接受全部6种处理，持续18天。哨兵受试者完成第19天后，申办方医学监查员将立即与研究者沟通，以确定继续给剩余受试者给药是否安全。

items.applicability: Within-subject topical treatment fields, vehicle and active comparators; application-device details are study-specific.
items.source_text:
A total of approximately 15 subjects with chronic plaque type psoriasis and with a treatment
area sufficient for 6 treatment fields on 1 to 3 comparable plaques defined as having
treatment fields with psoriatic skin infiltrate thickness/EPB of at least 200 μm will be
randomized to achieve approximately 15 evaluable subjects. The effect of the
PF-06763809 solutions will be assessed in comparison to the corresponding vehicle,
calcipotriene/calcipotriol and betamethasone solutions using the PPT, which also allows
within subject comparison of treatments. Subjects will be screened within 28 days prior to
application of investigational product to confirm that they meet the subject selection criteria
for the study. The total duration of participation in the study will be approximately 7-weeks
(minimum) to approximately 11-weeks (maximum), including the interval from Screening to
the Follow-up phone call visit (Day 49).
items.translated_text: 共计约15例慢性斑块型银屑病受试者将被随机分配，其治疗区足够大，可在1至3个可比斑块上设置6个治疗区，且这些治疗区的银屑病皮肤浸润厚度/EPB至少为200 μm，以达到约15例可评价受试者。将使用PPT评估PF-06763809溶液相对于对应的赋形剂、卡泊三烯/卡泊三醇和倍他米松溶液的效果，该PPT还允许进行受试者内治疗比较。受试者将在应用试验用药品前28天内接受筛选，以确认其符合研究的受试者选择标准。研究总参与时间约7周（最短）至约11周（最长），包括从筛选至随访电话访视（第49天）的时间间隔。

items.applicability: Flexible modified-release formulation and food-effect sequence; not a patient efficacy template.
items.source_text:
This is an open label, non-randomised single centre, two part, single dose study in
healthy male and female participants to assess MR prototype coated tablet formulations
of GSK2982772. The impact of food (high-fat breakfast) on the rate and extent of
absorption will be evaluated for suitable MR prototype coated tablet formulations, and an
assessment of alternative tablet strengths, dosing of multiple dose units and
presence/absence of apertures in the tablet may also be performed. An assessment of a
standard or high-fat breakfast/evening meal or study drug administration 30 or
60 minutes before a standard or high-fat breakfast or evening meal (Part B, Period 7 only)
may also be included. The single dose may be given in the morning or evening (Part B,
Period 7 only).

5.1.1.     Part A

Part A of the study is a non-randomised up to 6 period, 6-way fixed sequence design in
which up to 4 MR tablet prototype coated formulations may be evaluated following
single dose administration in the fasted state (240 mg) (Figure 1). Periods 1, 2 and 3 will
evaluate MR1 (similar in vitro dissolution to the slowest minitab MR formulation from
study 205017), IR Tablet (240 mg) and MR2 (slower in vitro dissolution than MR1)
respectively. Periods 4, 5 and 6 will be flexible and the dosing regimen will be dependent
on the outcome of Periods 1 to 3. In Periods 4 to 6, there will be the option to optimise
the MR release duration and evaluate the impact of a high-fat meal of one or more
already studied MR formulations. In addition, the impact of food (standard breakfast or
administration 30 or 60 minutes before a standard breakfast) on selected MR prototype
coated tablet formulations may also be evaluated in Period 5 or 6, as applicable. There
will also be the option to cancel Periods 5 and 6 if an optimal formulation is determined
in Periods 1 or 3 which shows no clinically significant food effect with a high-fat meal in
Period 4. There will be interim decisions after Periods 3, 4 and 5, where appropriate, to
determine the formulations and prandial status to be investigated in the next period.
Following the final period of Part A, there will be an interim review to determine whether
to proceed with optional Part B, and if so, the formulations and tablet strengths to be
investigated in Part B.
Each inpatient period for the MR regimens (Periods 1, 3, 4 to 6) will consist of 4 days
and 3 nights, and the inpatient period for the IR tablet (Period 2) will consist of 3 days
and 2 nights. There will be a minimum washout of 7 days between doses, and a
follow-up visit will occur at 7 to 9 days after the last study treatment. Participants will
receive a single oral dose of study treatment during each inpatient period.
items.translated_text:
这是一项开放标签、非随机、单中心、两部分、单次给药研究，在健康男性和女性受试者中进行，旨在评估GSK2982772的MR原型包衣片制剂。将评估食物（高脂早餐）对适宜MR原型包衣片制剂吸收速率和程度的影响，同时还可评估替代片剂规格、多个剂量单位给药以及片剂是否含孔。还可能包括对标准或高脂早餐/晚餐的评估，或在标准或高脂早餐/晚餐前30或60分钟给予研究药物的评估（仅B部分第7周期）。单次给药可在早晨或晚上进行（仅B部分第7周期）。

5.1.1. A部分

A部分研究采用非随机、最多6个周期、6种处理的固定顺序设计，在空腹状态下单次给药（240 mg）后，最多可评估4种MR原型包衣片制剂（图1）。第1、2和3周期将分别评估MR1（体外溶出与来自研究205017的溶出最慢的MR微片制剂相似）、IR片剂（240 mg）和MR2（体外溶出比MR1慢）。第4、5和6周期为灵活周期，给药方案将取决于第1至3周期的结果。在第4至6周期中，可选择优化MR释放持续时间，并评估一种或多种已研究MR制剂的高脂餐影响。此外，在第5或第6周期（视情况而定）还可评估食物（标准早餐或在标准早餐前30或60分钟给药）对所选MR原型包衣片制剂的影响。如果第1或第3周期确定了最佳制剂，且该制剂在第4周期的高脂餐作用下未显示出具有临床意义的食物效应，也可选择取消第5和第6周期。将在第3、4和5周期后（如适用）进行中期决策，以确定下一周期拟研究的制剂和进食状态。在A部分最后一个周期结束后，将进行中期审查，以确定是否继续进行可选的B部分，如果是，则确定B部分拟研究的制剂和片剂规格。

MR方案的每个住院期（第1、3、4至6周期）包括4天3夜，IR片剂的住院期（第2周期）包括3天2夜。两次给药之间至少设置7天洗脱期，并在末次研究治疗后7至9天进行随访访视。受试者将在每个住院期单次口服给予研究药物。

items.applicability: DDI administration sequence and continuous background-treatment window; all numbers remain product-specific.
items.source_text:
4.1.4     Drug assignment and administration of doses for each patient

Patients will take one tablet of Microgynon® at least 3 days before the first intake of
nintedanib (at Visit 2 in Period 1) and one tablet of Microgynon® after continuous nintedanib
administration for at least 10 consecutive days (at Visit 6 in Period 2). The remaining 19
tablets in the Microgynon® blister will not be used.
Nintedanib will be taken by the patients at home except for the PK profiling days. The
patients will be handed out the nintedanib medication (two bottles with 30 capsules each,
containing 150 mg nintedanib per capsule, for the respective time period) at the time point
indicated in the Flow Chart.
Nintedanib will be administered orally on a twice daily basis (b.i.d.). The nintedanib capsule
should be taken with food, swallowed whole with water (~250 mL) and must not be chewed
or crushed. Nintedanib needs to be taken with a dose interval of approximately 12 hours, i.e.
at approximately the same time every day: one capsule between 06:00 and 11:00 in the
morning, and one capsule between 18:00 and 23:00 in the evening.
items.translated_text:
4.1.4 每例患者的药物分配与给药

患者将在首次服用尼达尼布（第1周期第2次访视）前至少3天服用一片Microgynon®，并在连续服用尼达尼布至少10天后（第2周期第6次访视）服用一片Microgynon®。Microgynon®泡罩包装中剩余的19片将不再使用。
除PK分析日外，尼达尼布由患者在家中服用。患者在流程图所示时间点领取尼达尼布药品（每个时间段两个药瓶，每个药瓶30粒胶囊，每粒胶囊含150 mg尼达尼布）。
尼达尼布每日口服两次（b.i.d.）。尼达尼布胶囊应与食物同服，用水（约250 mL）整粒吞服，不得咀嚼或压碎。尼达尼布的服药间隔约为12小时，即每天大致相同的时间服用：早晨06:00至11:00之间一粒，晚间18:00至23:00之间一粒。

items.applicability: Fixed-sequence DDI allocation and IRT-controlled medication assignment in an autoimmune patient population.
items.source_text:
4.1.3     Method of assigning patients to treatment groups

This is a fixed sequence trial. After assessment of all in- and exclusion criteria, each eligible
patient will undergo the respective treatment periods in an identical order.

An Interactive Response Technology (IRT) will be used for this trial, which will manage the
IMP shipments to and returns from the sites. Allocation of the trial medication to the patient
will be done by the investigator or delegated person at the site. Further details will be
provided in the ISF.

The site will receive a sufficient supply of uniquely numbered Microgynon® and nintedanib
treatment packages and initially one Microgynon® blister package (containing 21 tablets) and
two (150 mg) nintedanib boxes will be assigned per patient. Additional nintedanib bottles
(containing 150 mg or 100 mg nintedanib capsules) will be assigned to a patient when
needed, e.g. if a patient has an adverse event (AE) resulting in temporary nintedanib
interruption or dose reduction leading to prolongation of the total treatment period. (See
further details in Section 4.1.4).
The assigned Microgynon® and nintedanib medication numbers will be recorded in the eCRF
for that patient.
items.translated_text:
4.1.3    受试者分配至治疗组的方法

本研究为固定顺序试验。在评估所有入选和排除标准后，每例合格受试者将按相同顺序接受相应的治疗期。

本研究将使用交互式应答技术（IRT）系统管理试验用药品（IMP）向中心的运送和从中心的退回。试验药物的分配由研究者或中心授权人员进行。更多详细信息见研究者文件夹（ISF）。

中心将收到足够数量的带唯一编号的Microgynon®和尼达尼布治疗药包，初始时每例受试者分配一个Microgynon®泡罩包装（含21片）和两盒尼达尼布（150 mg）。当需要时，例如受试者因不良事件（AE）导致暂停尼达尼布治疗或减低剂量致使总治疗期延长，将再分配额外的尼达尼布药瓶（含150 mg或100 mg尼达尼布胶囊）给该受试者（详见第4.1.4节）。

分配的Microgynon®和尼达尼布药物编号将记录在该受试者的电子病例报告表（eCRF）中。

items.applicability: Missed-dose, vomiting, dispensing and immediate dose-reduction operational clauses.
items.source_text:
The patient shall be instructed to not skip any doses. A forgotten or missed dose must be
skipped if the time window to the next dose is less than 8 hours. The next dose should be
taken as scheduled. Under no circumstances should two doses be taken at the same time. In
case of vomiting, the patient should not take a replacement dose.
The investigational product should only be dispensed to participating patients according to
the protocol by authorised personnel as documented in the form “Investigator’s Trial Staff
List”. The authorized person(s) must instruct the patients on how and when to take the
medication, how to store it and when to return the used and unused medication (bottles), in
addition to the instructions on the label.
In case of adverse events requiring dose reduction between planned visits (see Section 4.2.1
for details) an additional site visit is required. The dose can be reduced without prior
interruption, i.e., immediately stepping down from 150 mg b.i.d. to 100 mg b.i.d. The color of
capsules (100 mg capsule) will be slightly different.
items.translated_text:
应指导患者不得漏服任何剂量。遗忘或漏服的剂量，如果距离下次给药的间隔不足8小时，则必须跳过。下一次剂量应按计划服用。在任何情况下都不得同时服用两次剂量。发生呕吐时，患者不应补服剂量。
试验用药品仅可由已在“研究者试验工作人员名单”表格中列明的授权人员按照方案向参与研究的患者发放。除标签说明外，授权人员还必须指导患者如何及何时服用药品、如何储存药品以及何时退还已使用和未使用的药品（药瓶）。
如果在计划访视之间因不良事件需要降低剂量（详见第4.2.1节），则需要进行一次额外的研究中心访视。剂量可在不中断治疗的情况下降低，即直接从150 mg b.i.d.降至100 mg b.i.d.。100 mg规格胶囊颜色将略有不同。

items.applicability: 稳定背景治疗、序贯队列、随机分配和书面递增决策；内部研究用途权利待核。
items.source_text: The study will compare active TAK-079 with matching placebo in combination with a background SLE standard treatment, across 3 sequentially enrolling cohorts in a double-blinded study design. A 3:1 randomization, within each cohort, will assign each patient to TAK-079 administered as a single SC injection every 3 weeks for 12 weeks (total of 4 doses), or matching placebo given by the same route and schedule. Each cohort will enroll 8 patients; 6 patients will be randomized to TAK-079 and 2 patients to matching placebo. Key safety data will be reviewed and evaluated by Takeda clinicians or designees, who will review the safety of all treated patients and make decisions regarding dose escalation. All decisions will be documented in writing.
items.translated_text: 本研究将在一项双盲研究设计中，通过3个依次入组的队列，比较活性TAK-079联合背景SLE标准治疗与匹配的安慰剂联合背景SLE标准治疗。在每个队列内，按3:1随机化将每例受试者分配至TAK-079组（每3周给予单次SC注射，持续12周，共4剂）或匹配的安慰剂组（给药途径和给药方案相同）。每个队列将入组8例受试者；其中6例受试者随机分配至TAK-079组，2例受试者随机分配至匹配的安慰剂组。关键安全性数据将由武田临床医生或其指定人员进行审查和评估，他们将审查所有已接受治疗受试者的安全性，并就剂量递增做出决定。所有决定均将以书面形式记录。

items.applicability: 重复输注、输注后主动联系和无药随访；需携带终止状态和sponsor lineage。
items.source_text: This is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, repeat-dose, multicenter study. Approximately 25 subjects who meet the study eligibility criteria will be randomized on Day 1 in a 3:2 ratio to receive 8 infusions of TEPEZZA (10 mg/kg for the first infusion and 20 mg/kg for the remaining 7 infusions) or placebo q3W. During the 24-week double-blind Treatment Period, study drug will be infused on Day 1 and Weeks 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21 with a comprehensive visit at Week 24. After each of the first 2 infusions, subjects will be contacted by phone/email the following day. At the end of the Treatment Period, subjects will enter a 24-week Follow-up Period, during which study drug will not be administered and a clinic visit will be scheduled for Weeks 28, 36 and 48.
items.translated_text: 这是一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、重复给药、多中心研究。约25例符合研究入选标准的受试者将在第1天按3:2的比例随机分配，接受8次TEPEZZA输注（首次输注10 mg/kg，其余7次输注20 mg/kg）或安慰剂，每3周一次（q3W）。在24周双盲治疗期内，将在第1天和第3、6、9、12、15、18、21周输注研究药物，并在第24周进行全面的访视。前2次输注后，均将在次日通过电话/电子邮件联系受试者。治疗期结束后，受试者将进入24周随访期，在此期间不给予研究药物，并将在第28、36和48周安排研究中心访视。

items.applicability: FIH SAD/MAD、哨兵给药及跨队列安全性/PK放行；剂量和时间窗仅适用于来源研究。
items.source_locator: C4461001 Final Protocol Amendment 2, 10-Jul-2021, PDF page 41
items.source_text: Within 28 days of successful completion of the screening process, eligible participants will be randomized to receive a single IV infusion of PF-07242813 or placebo. In order to mitigate any unanticipated acute safety risks within the IV infused SAD cohorts, sentinel dosing will be implemented in all SAD cohorts where the dose being tested is the highest administered in the study to date. For sentinel dosing, the first 2 participants (1 active: 1 placebo) will be dosed prior to the remaining participants in the cohort and monitored for at least 24 h to assess safety. If the dose level for the first 2 sentinel participants is determined to have an acceptable safety and tolerability profile, as judged by the investigator, the remaining participants within the cohort will be dosed. Single dose cohorts will be enrolled sequentially in a dose escalating fashion starting from the lowest proposed dose (0.3 mg). During the SAD period, escalation to subsequent dose levels will occur following the sponsor's review of available safety through study Day 8 and PK data through Day 3 for the previous cohort. There will be a minimum of 10 days between cohorts for dose escalation.
items.translated_text: 在成功完成筛选过程的28天内，符合条件的受试者将被随机分配接受PF-07242813或安慰剂的单次IV输注。为降低IV输注SAD队列中任何不可预见的急性安全性风险，将在所有当前测试剂量为研究迄今最高给药剂量的SAD队列中实施哨兵给药。对于哨兵给药，前2名受试者（1例接受试验药物：1例接受安慰剂）将在该队列其余受试者之前给药，并至少监测24 h以评估安全性。如果研究者判定前2名哨兵受试者的剂量水平具有可接受的安全性和耐受性特征，则将对队列内其余受试者给药。单次给药队列将按照剂量递增方式依次入组，从最低拟定剂量（0.3 mg）开始。在SAD期间，在申办方审阅前一个队列截至研究第8天的安全性数据和截至第3天的PK数据后，方可进行后续剂量水平的递增。剂量递增队列之间将至少间隔10天。

items.applicability: Healthy-volunteer relative bioavailability, acid-reducing-agent and pediatric-formulation bridge.
items.source_text:
This is a Phase 1 randomized, crossover study in healthy participants to estimate the rBA of
abrocitinib oral suspension (Test formulation) compared to commercial abrocitinib tablet

(Reference formulation) under fasted condition. The effect of ARA on the BA of abocitinib
and its metabolites will be evaluated by administering abrocitinib 200 mg commercial tablet
with or without famotidine 40 mg as an ARA. Part B is to assess the taste and palatability of
6 different abrocitinib oral suspension formulations, to guide the selection and development
of abrocitinib pediatrics oral suspension formulation.
items.translated_text: 这是一项在健康受试者中进行的1期、随机、交叉研究，旨在评估空腹状态下阿布昔替尼口服混悬液（试验制剂）相对于市售阿布昔替尼片剂（参比制剂）的rBA。将通过给予阿布昔替尼200 mg市售片剂（联合或不联合40 mg法莫替丁作为ARA）来评价ARA对阿布昔替尼及其代谢产物BA的影响。B部分旨在评估6种不同阿布昔替尼口服混悬液制剂的口味和适口性，以指导阿布昔替尼儿科口服混悬液制剂的选择和开发。

items.applicability: Crossover, washout and gastric-pH DDI rationale; numerical choices remain compound-specific.
items.source_text:
4.2. Scientific Rationale for Study Design
Part A: A crossover design was used in the rBA part of the study following the FDA
guidance which states that a crossover study design is recommended for BA of IR dosage
forms. This crossover design reduces variability caused by patient-specific factors, thereby
increasing the ability to discern differences because of formulation.11

Washout period: The mean elimination half-life of abrocitinib is approximately 3-5 hours;
thus, a 25 hours washout period is considered adequate for the washout of the abrocitinib
from plasma. During PK sampling, it is the best practice to wait until plasma concentrations
are BLQ before administration of the next dose to minimize the carryover from the previous
treatment. Based on previous clinical experience with abrocitinib, a 72-hour washout period
is sufficient for plasma abrocitinib concentrations to return to BLQ after administration of a
single dose. Therefore, in this study, a 72-hour washout period has been selected between
each treatment period in Part A of the study.

Part A of the study will evaluate the effect of an ARA on abrocitinib BA. This assessment
has been conducted following the FDA guidance recommending that sponsors need to assess
the susceptibility of a weak base drug, like abrocitinib, to DDI mediated by gastric-pH
changes (referred to as pH-dependent DDIs). FDA guidance states that concomitant
administration of an ARA with a weak base drug could alter the BA of the drug. According
to the FDA guidance, when evaluating the effect of DDI mediated by gastric pH, it is
preferable to select an ARA that does not exhibit other interacting mechanisms. The effect of
PPI on CYP2C19 makes it a nonpreferable ARA selection to use in this study as it may
interfere with abrocitinib metabolism via CYP2C19. Administration of H2 blockers (eg,
famotidine) ahead (eg, 2 hours) of the investigational drug can maximize the pH-elevating
effect with a duration of action lasting ~10-12 hours.12,13
items.translated_text:
4.2. 研究设计的科学依据
A部分：在rBA部分采用了交叉设计，遵循FDA指导原则，该指导原则指出，对于IR剂型的BA，推荐采用交叉研究设计。11这种交叉设计可减少因受试者特异性因素引起的变异性，从而提高区分制剂间差异的能力。

洗脱期：阿布昔替尼的平均消除半衰期约为3-5小时；因此，25小时的洗脱期被认为足以使阿布昔替尼从血浆中清除。在PK采样期间，最佳做法是等待血浆浓度降至BLQ后再给予下一剂药物，以最大限度减少前一治疗的残留。基于阿布昔替尼既往的临床经验，单次给药后72小时的洗脱期足以使血浆阿布昔替尼浓度恢复至BLQ。因此，本研究在A部分的每个治疗期之间选择了72小时的洗脱期。

本研究A部分将评估ARA对阿布昔替尼BA的影响。该评估遵循FDA指导原则进行，该指导原则建议申办者需要评估弱碱性药物（如阿布昔替尼）对胃pH变化介导的DDI（称为pH依赖性DDI）的敏感性。FDA指导原则指出，ARA与弱碱性药物同时给药可能改变该药物的BA。根据FDA指导原则，在评估胃pH介导的DDI效应时，宜选择不表现出其他相互作用机制的ARA。PPI对CYP2C19的影响使其不宜选用作为本研究中的ARA，因为它可能通过CYP2C19干扰阿布昔替尼的代谢。在试验用药品给药前（例如，提前2小时）给予H2受体拮抗剂（例如，法莫替丁）可使pH升高效应最大化，作用持续时间约10-12小时。12,13

items.applicability: 既往生物制剂分层、皮肤与血液PD及患者报告结局；产品和适应症事实不得跨项目复用。
items.source_text: A multi-centre, 12-week, randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled study of GSK1070806 to investigate efficacy and safety in moderate-to-severe AtD participants. The study will assess the impact of GSK1070806 in two groups of patients with moderate-to-severe AtD: Group 1, patients naïve to biologic treatment (and who have failed topical therapies); and Group 2, patients who have not adequately responded (or have been intolerant) to dupilumab. Changes in the clinical signs of AtD as well as changes in disease biomarkers in blood and in skin (via serial biopsies and tape stripping) are to be assessed as well as patient reported outcomes, pharmacokinetics and anti-drug antibodies. The primary completion is at Week 12 and the End of Study Visit is at Week 24.
items.translated_text: 这是一项多中心、12周、随机、双盲、平行组、安慰剂对照研究，旨在评估GSK1070806在中重度AtD受试者中的疗效和安全性。该研究将评估GSK1070806对两组中重度AtD患者的影响：第1组，未接受过生物制剂治疗（且局部治疗失败）的患者；第2组，对度普利尤单抗应答不充分（或不耐受）的患者。将评估AtD临床体征的变化以及血液和皮肤中疾病生物标志物的变化（通过连续活检和胶带剥离取样），同时评估患者报告结局、药代动力学和抗药抗体。主要完成时间为第12周，研究结束访视为第24周。

items.applicability: Pediatric patient PK/PD study and dose-selection bridge; product- and age-specific facts must be replaced.
items.source_text:
This is an interventional, PK, PD, Phase 1, open label study in children 6 to less than 12
years of age with ≥50% scalp hair loss due to AA. The purpose of the study is to collect data
to support dose selection for subsequent studies in the same population.

Participants will be screened and, if all eligibility criteria are met, will receive the first dose
of IP within 28 days after the screening visit.
items.translated_text: 这是一项干预性、PK、PD、I期、开放标签研究，研究对象为因AA导致≥50%头皮脱发的6岁至不满12岁儿童。本研究旨在收集数据，以支持同一人群后续研究的剂量选择。受试者将接受筛选，如果符合所有入选标准，将在筛选访视后28天内接受首次IP给药。

items.applicability: Pediatric exposure matching, steady-state PK and sparse sampling rationale; requires product-specific model support.
items.source_text:
4.2. Scientific Rationale for Study Design
The PK assessments from this study are necessary to support ritlecitinib dose selection in
subsequent studies in children 6 to <12 years of age. The systemic exposure assessments
from this study will provide information on whether the selected dose for children 6 to
<12 years old provides exposures similar to the proposed dose for adolescents and adults.
The PD endpoints of IP-10 and lymphocyte subsets will be assessed to understand if there is
any difference in PD responses between children 6 to less than 12 years of age, and adults
and adolescents. The open-label, 7-day study design has been reviewed by the US FDA and
the EMA and agreed as part of the iPSP and PIP, respectively.

The 20 mg dose selected is predicted to provide exposures in 6 to <12 year old children,
similar to the 30 mg dose in adults and adolescents.

The study is designed as a 7 day multiple dose study. Multiple doses are necessary for
evaluating steady state PK because ritlecitinib has non stationary PK and steady state is
achieved after >4 days of dosing.

PK samples will be collected at times of pre-dose and post-dose times of 0.5, 1, 3 and
8 hours. These sample times were selected to enable estimation of PK parameters of AUC,
Cmax and Tmax using non-compartmental analysis methods. For calculation of AUCtau at
steady state, the predose concentration will be used as an estimate for the concentration of
24 hours post dose.
items.translated_text:
4.2. 研究设计的科学依据
本研究的PK评估对于支持利特昔替尼在6岁至<12岁儿童后续研究中的剂量选择是必要的。本研究的全身暴露评估将提供信息，以判断为6岁至<12岁儿童选择的剂量是否能提供与青少年和成人拟用剂量相似的暴露。将评估IP-10和淋巴细胞亚群的PD终点，以了解6岁至<12岁儿童与成人和青少年在PD应答上是否存在差异。该开放标签、7天研究设计已获得美国FDA和EMA审阅，并分别作为iPSP和PIP的一部分达成一致。

所选20 mg剂量预测可在6岁至<12岁儿童中提供与成人和青少年中30 mg剂量相似的暴露。

本研究设计为7天多次给药研究。由于利特昔替尼具有非平稳PK，且给药>4天后达到稳态，因此需要多次给药来评估稳态PK。

PK样本将在给药前和给药后0.5、1、3和8小时的时间点采集。选择这些采样时间是为了能够使用非房室分析方法估算PK参数AUC、Cmax和Tmax。对于稳态下AUCtau的计算，将使用给药前浓度作为给药后24小时浓度的估计值。

items.applicability: 儿科静脉转皮下给药、群体PK更新及按体重模拟给药频率；不是FIH剂量递增模板。
items.source_text: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the pharmacokinetic (PK) characteristics and safety of repeat doses of 200 mg belimumab subcutaneous (SC) in Chinese paediatric participants by leveraging the China belimumab IV paediatric study (213560), such that paediatric participants completing 48 weeks belimumab IV treatment could be rolled over to this belimumab SC study. The PK data derived from this study will contribute to the update of previous population PK model, and on the basis of the updated population PK model, an appropriate dose regimen of belimumab SC (i.e., dose frequency according to body weight) for Chinese paediatric participants will be determined by simulation.
items.translated_text: 本研究的目的是利用中国贝利尤单抗IV儿科研究（213560），评估200 mg贝利尤单抗皮下（SC）重复给药在中国儿科受试者中的药代动力学（PK）特征和安全性，使得完成48周贝利尤单抗IV治疗的儿科受试者能够转入本贝利尤单抗SC研究。本研究获得的PK数据将有助于更新既往的群体PK模型，并基于更新的群体PK模型，通过模拟确定中国儿科受试者适宜的贝利尤单抗SC剂量方案（即根据体重确定的给药频率）。
